trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 'So the obstruction is not a 3-dimensional representation (H_3 has none - its Wedderburn blocks are 1, 2, 1) nor a single knot invariant, but the two-crossing isospin amplitude difference.' Both denied alternatives are the ones a reader would actually reach for, and the first is refuted on the spot by a verified fact (blocks 1,2,1); this is substantive mathematical contrast.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Full read of the remark plus its 4-row sector table. RE-DERIVED every algebraic claim with sympy and all of it is exactly right: num(q) = (q-1)(q+1)R_12(q) with R_12 = q^12-4q^10+6q^8-10q^6+6q^4-4q^2+1; num(q) - (q^8-q^6).C(q^2+q^-2) = 0 identically, so Delta^odd = (h/4)C(y) is exact; C = y^3-4y^2+3y-2 has no rational root (C(1)=-2, C(-1)=-10, C(2)=-4, C(-2)=-32) hence is irreducible, disc(C) = -152 = -2^3.19 and is not a square so Gal = S_3; C_Hopf + C_unknot = (y^3-6y^2+10y-6) + (2y^2-7y+4) = C exactly; disc(C_Hopf) = -76 = -2^2.19, sharing the prime 19 as claimed; C(3) = -2, C(6) = 88, C(2) = -4 all nonzero at the golden/silver/classical anchors (y=3,6,2 all verified); and H_3's Wedderburn blocks are indeed 1,2,1 so there is no 3-dimensional rep. The ONE defect is the knot naming in the table, recorded separately. No trap of this category.
